symptoms: Small brown or black spots and yellowing around lesions.
cause: A leaf-spot disease with a cause that should be confirmed locally.
cultural_control: Remove badly affected leaves and dispose of them away from the field. Avoid overhead watering and improve air circulation.
chemical_option: Ask a local extension worker about a crop-approved treatment.
prevention: Keep foliage dry where possible and remove affected plant material.
see_officer_when: Seek a local extension worker when symptoms spread or the crop is badly affected.
source: Local Crop Doctor starter knowledge base
